steps.name: three-queued-then-one-ready
steps.detail: Assigned at10-1789366151-c1a/b/c to idle fx-at10-beta (--as fx-at10-alpha --team fx-at10). atm task list --json (--as fx-at10-beta) => positions 1,2,3 for c1a,c1b,c1c respectively. atm task events <id> --json shows only c1a's handoffs contain {"kind":"task_ready","trigger":"task_pass"}; c1b and c1c handoffs contain only {"kind":"task_queued"}. atm list --pending-ack --json (--as fx-at10-beta) run once after each of the three assignments: after c1a => {"count":0,"rows":[],"bucket_counts":{"unread":1,"pending_ack":0,"history":0}}; after c1b => {"count":0,"rows":[],"bucket_counts":{"unread":2,"pending_ack":0,"history":0}}; after c1c => {"count":0,"rows":[],"bucket_counts":{"unread":3,"pending_ack":0,"history":0}} — all three report pending_ack 0.

steps.name: close-releases-next
steps.detail: atm task start at10-1789366151-c1a (--as fx-at10-beta) then atm task close at10-1789366151-c1a completed (--as fx-at10-beta). Polled atm task events at10-1789366151-c1b --json at 1s/30s bound (--as fx-at10-beta); ready at iteration 3 (~3s): handoffs => [{"kind":"task_queued",...},{"kind":"task_ready","trigger":"task_pass","at":"2026-09-14T06:09:22.949365958Z"}]. atm task list --json (--as fx-at10-beta) afterward shows c1b at position 1, c1c at position 2.

steps.name: reassign-notifies-both
steps.detail: As fx-at10-alpha: assigned at10-1789366193-c3occ then at10-1789366193-c3 to beta (c3 queued position 2), then atm task assign fx-at10-gamma "reassigned" --task-id at10-1789366193-c3 --json => {"task_id":"at10-1789366193-c3"}. atm task events at10-1789366193-c3 --json (--as fx-at10-beta, identical --as fx-at10-gamma) => events: [{"event":"assigned","assignee":"fx-at10-beta"},{"event":"reassigned","assignee":"fx-at10-gamma","from_state":"assigned","to_state":"assigned"}]; handoffs: [{"agent":"fx-at10-beta","kind":"task_queued"},{"agent":"fx-at10-gamma","kind":"task_queued"},{"agent":"fx-at10-beta","kind":"task_closed"}]. Beta's queue shows the task closed (task_closed handoff) and gamma's atm task list --json shows the task now assigned/queued to gamma at position 1.

steps.name: move-head-readies-once
steps.detail: Assigned at10-1789366211-c4a then at10-1789366211-c4b to idle beta. Polled c4a events (--as fx-at10-beta) until ready at iter 3: handoffs=[{"kind":"task_queued"},{"kind":"task_ready","trigger":"task_pass"}] (exactly one task_ready). Then atm task move at10-1789366211-c4b --head --json (--as fx-at10-alpha) => {"task_id":"at10-1789366211-c4b","from":2,"to":1}. After the move: c4a events --json still shows exactly one task_ready handoff (unchanged from before); c4b events --json => handoffs=[{"kind":"task_queued"},{"kind":"task_ready","trigger":"task_pass","at":"2026-09-14T06:10:17.950666791Z"}] — exactly one task_ready. No duplicate ready event on either task.

steps.name: cancel-notifies-assignee
steps.detail: atm task assign fx-at10-beta "case5 task" --task-id at10-1789366230-c5 --json (--as fx-at10-alpha); beta's atm task list --json showed it queued/unstarted (state assigned, position 1, reminder_count 0). atm task close at10-1789366230-c5 cancelled "no longer needed" --json (--as fx-at10-alpha) while still unstarted. atm task events at10-1789366230-c5 --json (--as fx-at10-beta) => events include {"event":"cancelled","close_outcome":"cancelled","assignee":"fx-at10-beta","to_state":"complete"}; handoffs include {"agent":"fx-at10-beta","kind":"task_closed"}. atm list --json (--as fx-at10-beta) also shows the row {"message_id":"01M2F8KQADV4YGGDNFQ9V8KARK","summary":"no longer needed","from":"fx-at10-alpha","task_id":"at10-1789366230-c5"} delivered to beta.

steps.name: busy-assigner-sees-terminal-lines
steps.detail: atm task assign fx-at10-alpha "keep alpha busy" --task-id at10-1789366242-c6busy --json (--as fx-at10-gamma) made alpha busy (atm task list --json --as fx-at10-alpha showed it assigned/active). atm task assign fx-at10-beta "case6 task" --task-id at10-1789366242-c6 --json (--as fx-at10-alpha); beta then ran atm task start at10-1789366242-c6 "starting case6" and atm task close at10-1789366242-c6 completed "done case6" (--as fx-at10-beta). atm list --json (--as fx-at10-alpha) rows for task_id at10-1789366242-c6, ordered newest-first: {"message_id":"...D6TD","summary":"starting case6","from":"fx-at10-beta","timestamp":"2026-09-14T06:10:44.484242269Z"} followed later in the array by {"message_id":"...DZE3","summary":"done case6","from":"fx-at10-beta","timestamp":"2026-09-14T06:10:44.491827345Z"} — started (06:10:44.484) precedes completed (06:10:44.491) by timestamp, both present in alpha's unread list while alpha's own busy task was still assigned.

steps.name: cleanup
steps.detail: All tasks closed via atm task close: c1a/c1b/c1c completed (case1/2); c3occ, c3 completed (case3); c4a, c4b completed (case4); c5 closed via cancel (case5); c6 completed by beta, c6busy started+completed by alpha (case6). Final atm task list --json => [] for --as fx-at10-alpha, --as fx-at10-beta, and --as fx-at10-gamma (all empty, confirming clean idle state).
